name: Kami-Bound
body:
Kami are nature spirits that are usually bound to some sacred object or location, which is called their ward. However, in rare cases, a kami will bind itself to a human child at birth, using that child’s body as a kind of mobile shrine from which to further its mission in the world.

Physical

Kami-bound look just as human as the families into which they are born. They tend to be very beautiful and healthy but otherwise show no particular sign of being different, displaying the full breadth of diversity inherent to standard humans.

Social

Kami only rarely bond with humans, and don’t seem to bond with other humanoids.

They are most prevalent in areas that have been plagued by attacks from the oni, and it may be that kami-bound are the kami’s way of defending human communities when they sense the potential of oni corruption.

However, this does not always seem to be the case—and every kami-bound ends up with their own agenda in life.

All kami-bound seem blessed with almost preternatural serenity. They are at peace with the world around them, and have an uncanny awareness of nature, fey, and the movement of the spirits.

While many native outsiders (aasimars, tieflings, fair folk, and so on), kami-bound do not experience feelings of isolation and exclusion. They are happy to fully participate in human society, and embrace their roles in that society with passion and vigor.

At the same time, they never forget that they are part of a wider world that most humans never see—the spirit world. Some kami-bound feel the draw to lead a life of adventure, or to lead a secret double-life so that they can indulge this side of themselves outside of polite society. They dabble in the world of the fey, the arcane, and the occult.

Kami-bound often get along well with gnomes, gathlain, hengeyokai, and kitsune, and they may have friends and allies among other nature-loving peoples as well.

Alignment and Religion

More kami-bound are Lawful than Chaotic, but most are neutral on this axis, finding their purpose in a pragmatic centrism. While not all are Good, almost none are Evil.

Nevertheless, a kami-bound’s objectives and purpose tend to be directed to the spiritual and philosophical, which may bring them into opposition with those who are more focused on the physical realm, even if they share the same alignment.

Kami-bound often share the religious habits of the human communities they were raised in, although many also feel a deep connection to the spirit world that can draw them to druidism, shamanic practices, or esoteric philosophies. Whatever their faith, they are usually very aware of the hidden spirits around them, and careful to respect all faiths and cultures.

Base Traits
Ability Score Modifiers Kami-bound are extremely varied, benefiting both from the potential of their human body and from their kami spirit. You gain a +2 bonus to any one ability score of your choice [adaptable].
Size As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size.
Type You are an Outsider with the kami and native subtypes.
Speed Normal. Your base speed is 30 feet.
Languages You begin play speaking Common. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Aquan, Auran, Celestial, Giant, Sylvan, Terran, or any regional human tongue.
Alternate Traits
Senses Darkvision. You have darkvision 60 feet.
Dual-Minded As a creature created from two spirits bound together, you gain a +2 species bonus on all Will saving throws.
Heritage As a kami-bound, you must choose a heritage, which grants you additional species traits (see below).
Pass for Human In your normal form, you resemble an ordinary human. You gain a +10 species bonus on Disguise checks made to impersonate a standard human.
Skilled You gain a +2 species bonus on Diplomacy and Knowledge (nature) checks.
Kami-Bound Heritages
Forest

Forest kami-bound are born near regions of great, unspoiled woodlands. They delight in climbing the trees of an old-growth forest, cutting a trail through an unexplored rainforest, or meditating in a tranquil bamboo grove.

Spell-Like Abilities You can use pass without trace and speak with animals once per day each as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability.

Woodland Stealth You gain a +4 species bonus on Stealth checks while a forest or jungle terrain type.

Mountain

Mountain kami-bound are born near areas of hills, mountains, and badlands. They are most at home climbing the steep slopes, monitoring the rumble of an angry volcano, or exploring the caverns beneath the peaks.

Mountaineer You are immune to altitude sickness and do not lose your Dexterity bonus to AC when making Climb checks or Acrobatics checks to cross narrow or slippery surfaces.

Spell-Like Abilities You can use speak with animals and stone shield once per day each as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability.

Plains

Plains kami-bound are born into wide-open spaces, such as the scorching desert, the high plateau, or the windswept tundra.

Whether following a thundering herd across the prairie or picking your path carefully through wetlands, you always feel at home under an open sky.

Spell-Like Abilities You can use jump and speak with animals once per day each as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability.

Sprinter You gain a +10 foot species bonus to your speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions.

Sea

Sea kami-bound are born wherever human communities are tied to large bodies of water, whether ocean, lake, or river. They are equally at home sailing the high seas or patrolling the rocky shores.

Hold Breath You can hold your breath for a number of rounds equal to four times your Constitution score before risking drowning or suffocating.

Spell-Like Abilities You can use obscuring mist and speak with animals once per day each as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability.

Alternate Species Traits
Alternate Ancestry Although almost unheard of, your kami bonded with a different species instead of a human. You can speak the native language of your parents as an additional language, but you cannot choose human languages as bonus languages. If your parent species is Small, you are Small instead of Medium. You can pass for a member of your parents’ species instead of a human. This trait alters size, languages, and pass for human.
Healing Spirit Magic You can designate one grove, grotto, bay, mountain top, sea cave, or other remote natural area typical to the terrain preferred by your heritage (forest, mountain, plains, or sea). This area becomes your permanent sacred place, imbued with a portion of your kami spirit. If your sacred space is ever destroyed, you take one temporary negative level. You may designate a different sacred place by spending 8 hours to perform a special ceremony. Once per day while within your sacred place, you spend 1 minute to perform a ceremony that heals any one creature for 1d6 hit points per character level. This trait replaces dual-minded.
Kami Magic Your connection to the spirits bolsters your spellcasting abilities. Choose the option below that corresponds to your heritage. This trait replaces dual-minded.
Forest Magic: You are treated as 1 level higher when using powers of the Plant domain, bloodline powers of the verdant bloodline, and revelations of the oracle’s wood mystery. This trait does not give you early access to level-based powers; it only affects powers you could already use without this trait.
Mountain Magic: You are treated as 1 level higher when casting spells with the earth descriptor or using powers of the Earth domain, bloodline powers of the earth elemental bloodline, and revelations of the oracle’s stone mystery. This trait does not give you early access to level-based powers; it only affects powers you could already use without this trait.
Plains Magic: You are treated as 1 level higher when casting spells with the sonic descriptor or using powers of the Weather domain and bloodline powers of the stormborn bloodline. This trait does not give you early access to level-based powers; it only affects powers you could already use without this trait.
Sea Magic: You are treated as 1 level higher when casting spells with the water descriptor or using powers of the Water domain, bloodline powers of the water elemental bloodline, and revelations of the oracle’s waves mystery. This trait does not give you early access to level-based powers; it only affects powers you could already use without this trait.
Wanderer You gain a +2 species bonus on Knowledge (geography) and Survival checks. This trait replaces skilled.
Favored Class Bonuses
Barbarian Gain +1/3 of a skill or spell-like ability that you can use while raging. This benefit does not bestow you with any new skills or spell-like abilities; it simply allows you to use the ones you already have while you are raging.
Bard Add +1 to your total number of bardic performance rounds per day.
Bloodrager Add +1 to your total number of bloodrage rounds per day.
Brawler Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a bull rush or grapple combat maneuver.
Cleric Add +1/2 to your channeled energy total when healing creatures of the animal, fey, or plant type, or outsiders with the kami or native subtype.
Druid You gain energy resistance 1 against acid, cold, electricity, or fire. Each time you select this reward, increase your resistance to one of these energy types by +1 (maximum 10 for any one type).
Fighter Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a bull rush or sunder combat maneuver.
Kineticist Increase the amount of burn cost reduction when using your gather power ability by +1/6 point (the minimum burn cost of 0 still applies).
Magus Add +1/4 point to your arcane pool.
Medium When gaining a taboo, you can use spirit surge without incurring influence an additional +1/4 time per day. You must have the kami medium archetype to select this benefit.
Monk Add +1/4 point to your ki pool.
Ninja Add +1/4 point to your ki pool.
Occultist Increase your total number of points of mental focus by +1/2 point.
Oracle Add +1 spell known from the oracle spell list. This spell must be at least one spell level below the highest-level oracle spell you can cast.
Psychic Increase the total number of points in your phrenic pool by +1/3 point.
Ranger Gain a +1/2 bonus on damage dealt to outsiders with the oni subtype.
Rogue Add +1/2 on Bluff checks to pass secret messages, +1/2 on Diplomacy checks to gather information, and +1/2 on Disguise checks to appear as a human.
Samurai Gain +1/4 point of resolve.
Shaman Gains +1/6 of a new shaman hex.
Sorcerer Add +1 spell known from the sorcerer spell list. This spell must be at least one spell level lower than the highest-level sorcerer spell you can cast.
Witch Add +1/4 to your caster level when determining the effects of the spells granted to you by your patron.
Wizard Add +1/2 bonus on Knowledge (nature) and Knowledge (planes) checks.
